description: Source code for a video encoder delegate handling VP9 encoding via VAAPI, including rate control, frame setup, and reference management.

classes.name: VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for VP9 video encoding using VAAPI, managing rate control, frame setup, and reference frames.

classes.name: VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate::EncodeParams
classes.description: Structure holding encoding parameters such as keyframe interval, framerate, and QP settings.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder delegate with configuration, setting up size, rate control, and layers.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video frames.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames supported.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job by setting frame headers and parameters.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an encode job, including VP9-specific info.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control parameters based on encoding feedback.

methods.name: ApplyPendingUpdateRates
methods.description: Applies any pending rate updates to current parameters.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Requests a rate update with new bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: GetDefaultFrameHeader
methods.description: Creates a default VP9 frame header for keyframes or interframes.

methods.name: SetFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets up the frame header for a given frame, including reference frames and QP.

methods.name: UpdateReferenceFrames
methods.description: Refreshes the reference frame list with a new frame.

methods.name: SubmitFrameParameters
methods.description: Submits VAAPI buffers with sequence and picture parameters for encoding.
